claim.ja: 滑らかな複素射影Fano多様体について、Picard数とpseudoindexの不等式 ρ(X)(ι(X)−1) ≤ dim X、および等号時の射影空間の積による分類を主張する。
claim.en: For smooth complex projective Fano varieties, asserts ρ(X)(ι(X)−1) ≤ dim X and characterizes equality by products of projective spaces.

role.ja: Point descendantの下界と漸化式から固有値の独立性を得て、交代トレースで不等式を導く。等号時は曲線族と積の特徴付けを使う。
role.en: A descendant lower bound and a recurrence give independent eigenvalues; an alternating trace gives the inequality. Rational-curve families and a product characterization settle equality.
